text: The bug is clear: the regex replaces each non-alphanumeric character with a hyphen, but never collapses runs of hyphens or strips leading/trailing ones. Minimal fix:

arguments.old:
text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "-", text)
    return text
arguments.new:
text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "-", text)
    text = re.sub(r"-{2,}", "-", text)
    return text.strip("-")
